fusions.name: Scent Bite
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Circling Pass
fusions.desc: A circling pass that deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Feeding Frenzy
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 10 seconds, and you regain 8 health at once.

fusions.name: Taste of Blood
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your attacks heal you for 30% of the damage they deal for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
